metadata.title: The Travel Nurse's Guide to Short-Term Housing with Furnished Finder
metadata.author: Scrub Society
metadata.shortDescription:
The Gypsy Nurse's Spring 21 Virtual Conference Presents: 

The Travel Nurse's Guide to Short-Term Housing with Furnished Finder

This session is brought to you by AMN Healthcare


Finding housing as a travel nurse can be scary. Learn how to find short-term housing and avoid scams as well as learn how to stay safe in your home away from home with Brian and Cami from Furnished Finder.

About Furnished Finder:  family-run company founded in 2014, Furnished Finder is a short-term housing provider for travel nurses who need affordable monthly furnished housing. Property owners list their furnished rooms and apartments on Furnished Finder. They must pass a background check and provide proof of ownership/management for traveler safety and prevent scams. All rents are set directly by the landlord and there are no mark-ups or booking fees, making furnished housing affordable for travel healthcare professionals across the US. Furnished Finder has over 25,000 listings and is used by over 100 medical staffing companies.  Furnished Finder is committed to supporting the travel nurse industry by constantly innovating, preventing online housing scams, and improving to make finding affordable monthly furnished housing easier.

About Brian Payne: 
Co-founder and President of Furnished Finder. I’m excited and grateful to be in the position to help lead a growing web-based company in Denver, CO after an intensely rewarding 15-year career in healthcare. I’m surrounded by incredible people who keep me inspired and encouraged every day, and continually look for ways to challenge myself and put my family and company in the best possible position for success. 

About Cami Narino:
Chief Operating Officer at Furnished Finder, responsible for our customer satisfaction, brand growth and product quality. MBA with five years of experience working within the traveling nurse community.  Thankful for the opportunity to work with an amazing team of inspiring individuals and developing services that help medical professionals all over the U.S. Passionate about leadership and personal growth. Pet lover and avid reader! 

About AMN Healthcare:
WHY CHOOSE AMERICAN MOBILE? As the industry’s best travel nursing company, American Mobile is dedicated to the success of nurses everywhere. We understand the importance of partnering with an expert who values your needs, which is why we’re 100% committed to finding you an assignment that best matches your career and lifestyle goals. What makes American Mobile the best travel nursing company to work for? It is simple; experience. As a company of AMN Healthcare, we take pride in offering the nation’s largest database of travel nurses’ jobs throughout the entire U.S., in addition to the industry’s most comprehensive salary and benefits packages. Our team of experienced career specialists take the time to understand your needs and match you with the right job.

Watch more sessions from The Gypsy Nurse's Virtual Conference here: https://www.thegypsynurse.com/register-live-events/

#GypsyNurse #TravelNurse #HeyGypsy #TGNSpring21VirtualConference #TravelNurseConference

metadata.title: Furnished Finder 101: The Beginner's Guide to Monthly Midterm Rentals
metadata.author: Furnished Finder
metadata.shortDescription:
If you're a real estate investor exploring new ways to generate steady, low-maintenance income, this webinar is your perfect starting point. Hosted by Katie Lyon, Marketing Director at Furnished Finder and an experienced monthly midterm rental investor herself, you'll learn how to turn furnished properties into reliable monthly rentals, attract top-tier tenants like travel nurses and corporate professionals, and use Furnished Finder's tools to stay in control without booking fees.

In this video, you'll learn how to:
- Set up a compelling and high-performing listing on Furnished Finder
- Use photography, amenities, and great copy to attract quality tenants
- Understand the most common midterm rental tenant types, from travel nurses to relocating families
- Navigate the Furnished Finder dashboard and lead types
- Use built-in tools for tenant screening, lease agreements, online payments, and more

With over 300,000 properties listed nationwide and trusted by more than 225,000 landlords, Furnished Finder is the go-to platform for investors in the monthly midterm rental space. Whether you're launching your first rental or expanding your portfolio, this step-by-step guide gives you the knowledge and tools to succeed. You'll stay in full control with no booking fees and direct connections to verified tenants. Subscribe now and start building the kind of rental business that fits your goals.

🔗 Get Started with Furnished Finder Today:
 👉 Sign up here: https://www.furnishedfinder.com/list-your-property

📢 Join the Furnished Finder Community:
 🎙️ Listen to the Landlord Diaries Podcast: 
https://www.youtube.com/@thelandlorddiaries 
 💬 Connect with other landlords in our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1FU4m8MVYa/
